'''Busch Valentine:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} {{legend0|#6674de|60–70%}} {{legend0|#584cde|70–80%}} {{legend0|#3933E5|80–90%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Roy Blunt]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Eric Schmitt]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Missouri sidebar}} The '''2022 United States Senate election in Missouri''' was held on November 8, 2022, concurrently with [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] for all other [[Classes of United States senators|Class 3]] [[United States Senate|U.S. senators]] and [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections|elections]] for the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]], to select a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of [[Missouri]]. Incumbent Senator [[Roy Blunt]], a Republican, did not seek a third term in office. Republican Missouri Attorney General [[Eric Schmitt]] won the open seat, defeating Democrat Trudy Busch Valentine. ==Republican primary== In March 2021, incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Senator [[Roy Blunt]] announced that he would not seek reelection in 2022.{{cite news|last1=Ballentine|first1=Summer|last2=Salter|first2=Jim|date=March 8, 2021|title=GOP Sen. Roy Blunt of Missouri won't seek reelection in 2022|url=https://apnews.com/article/roy-blunt-will-not-seek-reelection-2022-687c91186e10fdf24a4f05bbc6959b80|url-status=live|access-date=March 9, 2021|website=|work=Associated Press|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210308165939/https://apnews.com/article/roy-blunt-will-not-seek-reelection-2022-687c91186e10fdf24a4f05bbc6959b80 |archive-date=March 8, 2021 }} Republican candidates for Blunt's Senate seat included former Gov. Vicky Hartzler launches Missouri Senate bid |url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/557775-gop-rep-vicky-hartzler-launches-missouri-senate-bid |work=The Hill |date=June 10, 2021}} U.S. Rep. [[Billy Long]],{{cite web|last=Bowman|first=Bridget|date=August 3, 2021|title=GOP Rep. Billy Long joins Missouri Senate race|url=https://www.rollcall.com/2021/08/03/gop-rep-billy-long-joins-missouri-senate-race/|url-status=live|access-date=August 3, 2021|website=[[Roll Call]]|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210804010343/https://www.rollcall.com/2021/08/03/gop-rep-billy-long-joins-missouri-senate-race/ |archive-date=August 4, 2021 }} and Missouri Attorney General [[Eric Schmitt]].{{cite web|date=March 24, 2021|title=Eric Schmitt joins Missouri race for U.S. Senate seat being vacated by Roy Blunt |url=https://missouriindependent.com/2021/03/24/eric-schmitt-joins-missouri-race-for-u-s-senate-seat-being-vacated-by-roy-blunt/|access-date=March 24, 2021|website=Missouri Independent|language=en-US}} Schmitt's candidacy was backed by Missouri mega-donor [[Rex Sinquefield]].{{Cite web|title=GOP Missouri Attorney General Schmitt running for US Senate|url=https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/gop-missouri-attorney-general-schmitt-running-us-senate-76651572|access-date=July 18, 2021|work=ABC News|language=en}} In the speech announcing his candidacy, Schmitt tied himself to Donald Trump and spoke against "the radical left". He pledged to vote against [[Mitch McConnell]] for the Senate [[Senate Minority Leader|Republican party leadership position]].{{Cite news |last=Keller |first=Rudi |date=July 28, 2022 |title=After months of wavering, Schmitt comes out against McConnell days before Senate primary |url=https://missouriindependent.com/2022/07/28/after-months-of-wavering-schmitt-comes-out-against-mcconnell-days-before-senate-primary/ |access-date=August 8, 2022 |newspaper=Missouri Independent |language=en-US}} In February 2022, Hartzler's campaign released a 30-second ad criticizing Lia Thomas, a [[transgender]] swimmer on the [[University of Pennsylvania]] women's team. In the ad, Hartzler said, "Women's sports are for women, not men pretending to be women", adding that, as Missouri's senator, she would not "look away while woke liberals destroy women's sports."{{cite web|first=Natalie|last=Adamson|url=https://www.politico.com/news/2022/02/13/missouri-senate-ad-slams-transgender-athletes-00008540|title=Senate ad slams transgender athletes 'pretending to be women'|website=[[Politico]]|date=February 13, 2022|accessdate=February 14, 2022}} U.S. Sen. [[Josh Hawley]] endorsed Hartzler in February 2022.{{cite news |last1=Allison |first1=Natalie |title=Missouri Senate poll alarms GOP |url=https://www.politico.com/news/2022/02/16/missouri-senate-poll-alarms-gop-00009317 |access-date=February 16, 2022 |work=POLITICO |date=February 16, 2022 |language=en}} On July 8, 2022, [[Donald Trump]] refused to endorse Hartzler, saying, "I don't think she has what it takes to take on the Radical Left Democrats."[https://news.yahoo.com/trump-says-won-t-endorse-191005744.html Trump says he won't endorse Vicky Hartzler, calls Eric Greitens 'smart' and 'tough'], ''[[Yahoo News]]'', Jason Hancock, July 9, 2022. Retrieved July 12, 2022. Greitens was endorsed by former New York City mayor [[Rudy Giuliani]], former [[U.S. Secretary of the Interior]] [[Ryan Zinke]], and [[Fox News]] personality [[Kimberly Guilfoyle]], the latter joining his campaign as a national chair.{{cite web|first=Quint|last=Forgey|url=https://www.politico.com/news/2021/04/19/kimberly-guilfoyle-eric-greitens-campaign-483049|title=Kimberly Guilfoyle joins Greitens' Senate campaign as national chair|website=[[Politico]]|date=April 19, 2021|access-date=March 22, 2022}} Many Republican officials, strategists, and donors maneuvered to stymie Greitens's attempted comeback, believing that the scandal surrounding his resignation as governor, his extramarital affair, and the sexual assault accusation against him would make him a weak general election candidate and lead to the loss of the Senate seat to a Democrat.Alex Isenstadt, [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/08/02/eric-greitens-attempted-comeback-00049388 Inside the secret, yearlong campaign to torpedo Eric Greitens' attempted comeback], ''Politico'' (august 2, 2022). Notable Republican opponents of Greitens's candidacy included [[Karl Rove]], [[Johnny DeStefano]], and Senator [[Rick Scott]], the chairman of the [[National Republican Senatorial Committee]].David Weigel, [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2022/08/01/trump-greitens-missouri-senate/ Trump endorses 'ERIC' in Missouri primary, a name shared by rivals], ''Washington Post'' (August 1, 2022). After Greitens's ex-wife filed an affidavit against him in March 2022 accusing him of physical abuse, Senator [[Josh Hawley]] (who had endorsed [[Vicky Hartzler]] the previous month{{Cite web|last=Bacharier|first=Galen|date=February 12, 2022|title=Josh Hawley endorses Vicky Hartzler for Missouri's open U.S. Senate seat|url=https://www.news-leader.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/02/12/hawley-endorses-vicky-hartzler-missouri-u-s-senate-race/6765929001/|access-date=February 12, 2022|website=[[Springfield News-Leader]]}}) called upon Greitens to drop out.{{cite news |url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/599088-hawley-says-eric-greitens-should-drop-out-amid-abuse-allegations/ |title=Hawley says Greitens should drop out of Senate race amid abuse allegations |date=March 21, 2022 |website=[[The Hill (newspaper)|The Hill]] |first=Kelsey |last=Carolan |access-date=July 17, 2022 }} Republican megadonor [[Richard Uihlein]] funded a pro-Greitens [[super PAC]] ("Team PAC"), contributing $2.5 million to it.{{cite news |url=https://www.politico.com/news/2021/07/06/gop-megadonor-eric-greitens-498347 |title=GOP megadonor bankrolling super PAC for Eric Greitens |date=July 6, 2021 |work=[[Politico]] |first=Alex |last=Isenstadt |access-date=July 29, 2021 }} Other Republican megadonors, including [[Rex Sinquefield]] and [[August Busch IV|August Busch]], aligned against Greitens. A Republican-funded anti-Greitens [[super PAC]] ("Show Me Values PAC") was created in June 2022{{Cite web |last=Isenstadt |first=Alex |title=Republicans launch super PAC to stop Greitens in Missouri |url=https://www.politico.com/news/2022/06/23/republicans-launch-super-pac-to-stop-greitens-in-missouri-00041791 |access-date=2022-07-17 |website=POLITICO |date=June 23, 2022 |language=en}} and ran $6.2 million in ads through late July 2022.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbcnews.com/meet-the-press/meetthepressblog/anti-greitens-group-spends-big-missouri-senate-primary-rcna39998|title=Anti-Greitens group spends big in Missouri Senate primary|date=July 26, 2022|website=NBC News}} Republican officials, including Rick Scott, waged a campaign to persuade Donald Trump not to endorse Greitens. On the eve of the primary election, Trump issued a statement endorsing "ERIC" in the primary, leaving it unclear which "Eric" he was endorsing.Martin Pengelly, [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/aug/02/trump-endorses-eric-greitens-schmitt-missouri-republican-primary Donald Trump endorses 'Eric' in Missouri primary – but which one?], ''The Guardian'' (August 2, 2022). In the primary election, Schmitt prevailed with 45.7% of the vote; Hartzler received 22.1%, Greitens 18.9%, and Long 5%.
